subscriptions_note: No subscriptions on this account: no card payment repeats from the same merchant every month for the same amount (no streaming, gym or app charges). Say so plainly; never invent one.
what_can_be_done: Monthly investing (203.25 EUR a month) is the regular payment the person chose: it can be paused with their PIN (create_pause_investing_link). What is already invested stays invested.
Rent can't be stopped here. Oiva reminds the day before it is due, and it can be paid with the PIN (create_payment_link with its bill_id from get_upcoming_bills).
Utility bills can't be stopped here. Oiva flags a bill well above the usual range.
method: From your S-Pankki transactions: a payment type that comes about once a month (median gap 20-40 days); per month = the average of the last 3 payments (utilities: of the last 3 full months); usual day = median day of the last 6; stopped = no payment for longer than the usual gap + 10 days; trend = last 3 full months vs the 3 before.
